trace.notes: Parsed a 30-page paper titled 'Open problems on k-orbit polytopes'. Major sections: 1 Introduction; 2 Background (2.1 Polytopes, 2.2 Automorphisms and k-orbit polytopes, 2.3 The flag action); 3 Coverings and mixing (3.1 Coverings, 3.2 Mixing); 4 Constructions of k-orbit polytopes (4.1 Basic existence questions, 4.2 Amalgamations and extensions); 5 Realizations (5.1 Realizations in a given space, 5.2 Realizations of a given polytope); 6 Acknowledgements; References. Explicit open problems appear as numbered Problem 1 through Problem 35 on pages 5, 7-9, 11, 14-25.
Collected Problems 1-9 from Sections 2.2, 3.1, and 3.2 on automorphism groups, coset geometry, coverings, monodromy, chirality groups, and mixes.
Collected Problems 10-14 from Section 4.1 on existence of k-orbit polytopes, prescribed automorphism groups, allowable symmetry type graphs, and convex symmetry type graphs.
Collected Problems 15-19 from Section 4.2 on amalgamations, universal rooted amalgamations, bounded flag-orbit classes, universal extensions, and mixed facet types.
Collected Problems 20-35 from Section 5 on Euclidean and hyperbolic realizations, full-rank and nearly full-rank classifications, convexity bounds, and realization theories.
Normalized each numbered problem into a standalone question string, lightly expanding notation such as E^d and H^3 where helpful while preserving the original mathematical content.
Accepted all 35 numbered Problem entries because each has explicit source wording and page-cited evidence. No item was marked solved in the source, so all meta.is_solved values are false.
